message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: operating small electroplating without permits, no wastewater treatment, discharging waste water containing heavy metal chromium 12 mg/L, exceeding standards threefold. This is environmental pollution. Under Chinese Criminal Law, article 338 (formerly) "environment pollution crime" (environmental pollution crime). Thus final answer: {"final_answer": "[罪名]环境污染罪<eoa>"}
